{{External|rs|rsc=Black 2-handed Sword}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black 2h sword |image = [[File:Black 2h sword.png]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A two handed sword. |value = 1920 |weight = 3.628 |exchange = Yes |id = 1313 }} [[File:Black_2h_sword_detail.png|left|80px]] The '''black 2h sword''' is a [[two-handed sword]] stronger than the [[steel 2h sword]], requiring level 10 [[Attack]] to wield. Players can purchase this two-handed sword from [[Gaius' Two Handed Shop]] in [[Taverley]]. It can also be a reward from the [[Observatory Quest]], from the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton minigame]], completing a [[Treasure Trails|Treasure Trail]] or as a drop from various monsters. As with all [[Black equipment|black]] and [[white equipment]], the black 2h sword cannot be made from raw materials using the [[Smithing]] skill. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = -4 |aslash = +27 |acrush = +21 |amagic = -4 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = -1 |str = +26 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 7 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = 2h Sword |image = [[File:Black 2h sword equipped male.png|140px]] |altimage = [[File:Black 2h sword equipped female.png|140px]] }} {{CombatStyles|2h Sword|speed=7|attackrange=1}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black 2h sword}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black 2h sword}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 23 August 2005 |update = Blast Furnace |change = The item's equip animation was changed. }} {{Subject changes |date = 31 May 2005 |update = New Emotes And Other Tweaks |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black 2h sword detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black 2h sword detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black 2h sword detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black 2h sword detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black 2h sword (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black 2h sword (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Black 2h sword.png|center]] |[[File:Black 2h sword.png|center]] |- | |[[File:Black 2h sword equipped male (historical v1).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Black 2h sword equipped male (historical v2).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Black 2h sword equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |RuneScape 2
